title: Connect, authenticate, choose library and begin synchronization
journey: A reachable test server is a precondition, not Connect implementation; installer completion, profile/auth/library readiness and sync start are separate; client owns sync; non-empty folders are not deletion state.

platform.desktop_session: required for graphical desktop journeys; otherwise not applicable

preconditions: Disposable dedicated acceptance identity and scenario-owned state.
No prior Synveil installation, package registration, installer-owned integration or stale acceptance state unless a declared upgrade/recovery source is required.
A brand-new OS and removal of unrelated user files are not required.
Seed a non-empty scenario-owned local folder with a marker file to verify safe existing-folder onboarding.

steps.description: Launch through the supported installed entrypoint.
Connect to the pre-provisioned test server.
Authenticate using the canonical credential owner.
Choose or create the authorized library.
Observe synchronization start as a distinct milestone.

assertions.description: Profile configuration is ready after choosing Connect.
Server authentication succeeds without recording credential bytes in config or output.
Credential is durably stored by the OS SecretStore and usable by the next product operation.
Authorized library selection and local folder binding complete.
Client-owned synchronization begins as a milestone separate from install and first-run completion.
Desktop/client control remains local and scoped to the signed-in user.
Connect onboarding and initial sync start require no terminal.

forbidden_outcomes.description: Installer lifecycle deletes user library content.
Credential value is written to ordinary config or diagnostics.
Unknown or newer schema is reset or downgraded.
Persistent startup is enabled without explicit user consent.
Desktop control is exposed through a public TCP/HTTP listener.
An ambiguous mutation is blindly replayed without authoritative reconciliation.
Installation is reported complete before payload, integration and launch verification.
An existing non-empty chosen local folder is treated as authoritative deletion state or its files are silently removed.
